newsitem.title: USA: 18 state agriculture commissioners endorse Clinton.
newsitem.headline: 18 state agriculture commissioners endorse Clinton.

text.p: Eighteen state agricultural commissioners on Wednesday endorsed President Bill Clinton for re-election, saying that the administration has put U.S. agriculture back on the right track to prosperity.
"This president, and his vision to build a bridge to the twenty-first century, is including farmers on that bridge," said Florida agricultural comissioner Bob Crawford.
The state officials -- all Democrats -- along with Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman, said administration policies have helped net farm income and agricultural exports reach record levels.

The agricultural commissioners represented Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, New Hampshire, North Carolina, North Dakota, Oregon, Vermont, Washington and West Virginia.
